description: This shell script contains functions related to reading binary filesystem images, determining filesystem types based on magic words, and computing aligned sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the first 4 bytes of a file to determine a magic word for identifying filesystem type.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Extracts 4 bytes after root filesystem data that could contain a specific marker.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type based on the magic word and optional post-padding marker.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Rounds up a number to the nearest multiple of a specified value.
